items.title: Common Multiples and Common Factors
items.explanation: The 'idli-vada' game demonstrates the concept of common multiples. When two numbers are both multiples of each other, their common multiples include all multiples of the smaller number (say, 'idli') and all multiples of the larger number (say, 'vada'). The first number where both players say 'idli-vada' is called a Common Multiple.

items.title: Common Factors
items.explanation: Common factors are numbers that divide two or more numbers exactly. In the treasure hunting game, Jumpy gets a treasure if he lands on a number where Grumpy placed it. The jump sizes that land on both treasures are the common factors of those two numbers.
